title: Calibrated Triage, Not Autonomy: Confidence Estimation for Medical Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.15910v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A vision-language model can answer a question about a chest radiograph or a pathology slide fluently and confidently while barely using the image, relying instead on language priors. In medicine this is the failure that matters most: the answer looks trustworthy and is not, and the natural safeguard is a confidence score reliable enough to say when the model should abstain. We ask a deployment question rather than an accuracy one: how much medical imaging work a vision-language model can safely defer on its own, and which confidence signal makes that possible. We evaluate nine confidence estimators, spanning training-free logit baselines, prompt-based self-reports, and trained internal probes, across five open-weight LVLMs and three medical VQA datasets covering broad clinical imaging, radiology, and pathology, every probe trained only on natural images and applied to medicine without adaptation. translated_title: 校准分诊，而非自主决策：医学视觉语言模型的置信度估计
translated_abstract: 一个视觉语言模型可以流畅且自信地回答关于胸部X光片或病理切片的问题，却几乎不使用图像信息，而是依赖语言先验。在医学领域，这是最关键的失败模式：答案看似可信实则不然，而自然的防护措施是获得足够可靠的置信度分数，以判断模型何时应放弃回答。我们提出的不是准确性问题，而是部署问题：视觉语言模型能安全地独立处理多少医学影像工作，以及哪种置信度信号能实现这一点。我们评估了九种置信度估计器，涵盖无需训练的logit基线、基于提示的自我报告以及训练过的内部探针，在五个开放权重的大型视觉语言模型和三个覆盖广泛临床影像、放射学和病理学的医学视觉问答数据集上进行测试，所有探针仅使用自然图像训练并直接应用于医学领域，无需适应。研究被重构为有界选择性预测。
tldr: 本文提出通过评估九种置信度估计器，证明在医学视觉语言模型中，校准分诊比自主决策更可靠，并指出仅用自然图像训练的置信度探针能有效决定模型何时应放弃回答。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates nine confidence estimators and demonstrates that calibrated triage outperforms autonomy in medical vision-language models, showing that probes trained solely on natural images can reliably determine when the model should abstain.
